_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. IDs (list/field/option) are discovered with `python3 clickup.py --discover` once the ClickUp fields exist. Money is in USD.

pricing._markup_note: Flat markup on the Amazon CHECKOUT total (item + shipping + import fees). 0.10 = +10%.

clickup._list_note: Recommended: the existing 'AZ Orders Batch (2)' list so an order keeps one task its whole life.

order_status_options._note: logical order-lifecycle state -> ClickUp dropdown option id (filled by --discover)

sheets._mode_note: 'csv' = write a clean orders_export.csv (zero-dependency). 'api' = write straight to a Google Sheet via a service account (needs GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS + google-api-python-client).

profiles._note: Multilogin profile/box -> daily order-capacity cap (anti-detection). order_placer assigns the box with remaining capacity.

serpapi._note: Optional pre-order ESTIMATE only (item price, not landed). Keys come from .env (SERPAPI_KEY / _2 / _3). Each call costs ~30 credits — estimates are cached.

fx._note: USD is the P&L currency. Rates convert any genuinely non-USD figure. The Amazon 'Total Amount' is already USD (value_is_usd:true), so no rate applies to it.

amazon_cost._note: Otloble AMAZON space -> Orders list. 'Total Amount' is labelled ILS but values are USD.

revenue._note: Customer revenue. mode 'gsheet' reads a link-readable Google Sheet live (no credentials); 'sheet' uses a service account; 'orders' uses local orders.json.
revenue.amount_column: amount to be collected IN $ USD

meta._note: Meta ad spend. mode 'api' pulls via the Marketing API (META_* in .env). campaign_filter (substring of campaign name) counts ONLY that campaign — these customers came from one campaign.

clickup_po._note: Push Amazon purchase orders to the Otloble AMAZON / Orders list as a parent 'Order #' task + one subtask per item.

estimate._note: Customer price estimator. SerpApi gives the item price; it CANNOT read Amazon's destination shipping/import, so set your typical values here.

business._note: Otlobly WhatsApp number in international format, e.g. 970599... — used by the 'message us' button.

pipeline._note: Customer delivery ETA = PO package arrival + this many days (GAASH last-mile to Palestine).
